subject.title: perf(gateway): reuse request-scoped store caches in mutation authorization

question: Should this maintainer-owned gateway performance optimization land after a current-base refresh and real after-fix performance proof?
rationale: The patch changes authorization-path caching and is protected by the `maintainer` label; tests support the intended invariant, but acceptance of the performance evidence and current-base merge result requires owner judgment.

options.title: Refresh and prove before merge
options.body: Rebase the PR, then post a redacted real gateway trace or benchmark showing the request-scoped materialization reduction while preserving authorization outcomes.

options.title: Pause the optimization
options.body: Keep the existing behavior until a production-representative proof path is available if the cache benefit cannot be demonstrated safely.

recommendation.title: Refresh and prove before merge
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, then post a redacted real gateway trace or benchmark showing the request-scoped materialization reduction while preserving authorization outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in the same session-store cache and gateway sharing paths makes this the strongest available routing candidate.
